body.name: Licensing and Consumer Services
body.notes: BC Housing’s Homeowner Protection Office branch took on builder licensing, owner-builder authorization, and research and education on April 1, 2010. Its work included monitoring mandatory home warranty insurance and helping protect new-home buyers. BC Housing was using the name Licensing and Consumer Services by February 2017.

sources.title: 2010 transfer of Homeowner Protection Act responsibilities
sources.note: BC Housing received licensing, owner-builder authorization, research and education. Administration of the Reconstruction Program passed to the Ministry of Finance.

sources.title: BC Housing 2012/13–2014/15 Service Plan
sources.note: Describes the Homeowner Protection Office as a branch of BC Housing and dates the transfer to fiscal 2010/11.

sources.title: BC Housing 2017/18–2019/20 Service Plan
sources.note: Names Licensing and Consumer Services as the former Homeowner Protection Office branch and describes its compliance role.

assets.notes: The 2016 cover shows a teal roofline interlocking with blue and teal diamonds above the branch name and endorsement. The branch licensed residential builders and building envelope renovators, authorized owner-builders, monitored home warranty requirements, and provided research and education. BC Housing’s February 2017 service plan uses the name Licensing and Consumer Services.
